tool.name: add_entity_relation
tool.title: Add Entity Relation
tool.description: Add a relation between existing entities or add a hashtag to your own post.

tool.name: add_list_item
tool.title: Add List Item
tool.description: Add a post or an RSS feed item to a list the current user owns. Adding an item that is already on the list returns the existing entry. A post is only available if the user can see it; the user's own private posts additionally need the private-post consent scope.

list_id.description: The ID of a list the current user owns.

item_type.description: The kind of item: a post or an RSS feed item.

entity_id.description: The ID of the post or feed item.

tool.name: compare_topics
tool.title: Compare Topics
tool.description: Compare data point statistics side-by-side for two topics (cards, bank accounts, etc.). Useful for answering questions like "which card has a better approval rate?"

topic_id_a.description: UUID or slug of the first topic to compare

topic_id_b.description: UUID or slug of the second topic to compare

vertical.description: Optionally filter to a specific data point vertical

tool.name: create_list
tool.title: Create List
tool.description: Create a new list owned by the current user. Lists are private with no description unless set otherwise. Every call creates a new list, even when the name is already taken.

description.description: A description of the list, or null for none.

visibility.description: Who can see the list. Lists are private unless set otherwise.

tool.name: delete_list
tool.title: Delete List
tool.description: Delete a list the current user owns, along with its items. Deleting a list that is already deleted fails as not found, and another user's list cannot be deleted.

list_id.description: The ID of a list the current user owns.

tool.name: get_community_members
tool.title: Get Community Members
tool.description: List the members of a public community by its UUID or slug, as a signed-out reader sees the roster: the owner and moderators always, and regular members only when the community lets the public see them (member_roster_visibility: public). Returns at most 25 members per page and page_info.end_cursor; pass it as after to get the next page. A private, deleted or unknown community returns { success: false, error: "Community not found" }. A malformed cursor returns { success: false, error: "Invalid cursor" }.

after.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page_info.end_cursor, for the next page.

tool.name: get_community_pinned_posts
tool.title: Get Community Pinned Posts
tool.description: Get the posts a public community has pinned, in pin order, by its UUID or slug, as a signed-out reader sees them: an anonymous post never names its author, whoever asks. A pinned post the public cannot see is left out. A private, deleted or unknown community returns { success: false, error: "Community not found" }.

tool.name: get_community_posts
tool.title: Get Community Posts
tool.description: List the approved posts of a public community by its UUID or slug, newest first or by hot, as a signed-out reader sees them: an anonymous post never names its author, whoever asks. q matches post text and may carry #hashtags. Pinned posts are left out of every unfiltered page; their ids come back in pinned_post_ids on the first unfiltered page only (read them with get_community_pinned_posts). Returns at most 25 posts per page and page_info.end_cursor; pass it as after, with the same sort, to get the next page. A private, deleted or unknown community returns { success: false, error: "Community not found" }. A malformed cursor, or one from a different sort, returns { success: false, error: "Invalid cursor" }.

sort.description: Sort order: new (most recent, the default) or hot

q.description: Keyword search over the posts. Same as the REST q: matches text and #hashtags.

after.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page_info.end_cursor, for the next page.

tool.name: get_community
tool.title: Get Community
tool.description: Get one community by its UUID or slug: its name, description, rules, owner and public counts. Only public communities are readable, for every caller: a private, deleted or unknown community returns { success: false, error: "Community not found" }, even to its own members, moderators and owner. Use get_community_posts, get_community_pinned_posts and get_community_members to read inside it.

tool.name: get_domain_ratings
tool.title: Get Domain Ratings
tool.description: Look up trust signals for a linked source. Provide exactly one of url or hostname. Returns hostname/domain trust votes and, when a URL maps to an RSS source, the associated source topic ratings and metrics.

hostname.description: A bare hostname/domain to inspect, such as example.com

tool.name: get_list_items
tool.title: Get List Items
tool.description: List the items on a list, newest first: each is a post or an RSS feed item, with the item_type and entity_id to read it with (get_post, or the RSS item tools). The list must be readable as get_list describes; otherwise this returns { success: false, error: "List not found" }. A post the caller cannot read, such as a private or deleted post, is left out, so a page can hold fewer items than limit while page_info.has_next_page is still true: keep paging until it is false. media_type keeps only RSS feed items of that media type. Returns at most 25 items per page and page_info.end_cursor; pass it as after to get the next page. A malformed cursor returns { success: false, error: "Invalid cursor" }.

media_type.description: Only RSS feed items of this media type

after.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page_info.end_cursor, for the next page.

tool.name: get_list
tool.title: Get List
tool.description: Get one list by its UUID: its name, description, owner and visibility. Public and unlisted lists are readable by anyone who has the id. A private list is readable only by its owner, and only when the credential holds the post-relations.owned-private:write private-data consent scope (the mcp.user:write scope does not include it). Every other case, including an unknown, removed or another user's private list, returns the same { success: false, error: "List not found" }. Use get_list_items to read inside a list.

tool.name: get_my_cards
tool.title: Get My Cards
tool.description: List the current user's wallet cards.

after.description: Opaque cursor from the previous list page

limit.description: Number of cards to return, from 1 to 100

tool.name: get_my_point_valuations
tool.title: Get My Point Valuations
tool.description: List the current user's rewards program point valuations.

after.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page

limit.description: Number of valuations to return, from 1 to 100

tool.name: get_my_profile
tool.title: Get My Profile
tool.description: Get the current user's wallet profile including their cards, point valuations, rewards program statuses.

cards_after.description: Opaque cursor from the previous cards page

cards_limit.description: Number of cards to return, from 1 to 100

point_valuations_after.description: Opaque cursor from the previous point valuations page

point_valuations_limit.description: Number of point valuations to return, from 1 to 100

rewards_program_statuses_after.description: Opaque cursor from the previous rewards program statuses page

rewards_program_statuses_limit.description: Number of rewards program statuses to return, from 1 to 100

tool.name: get_my_financial_profile
tool.title: Get My Financial Profile
tool.description: Read the current user's credit score range, stated income range, total credit limit and years of credit history.

tool.name: get_my_lists
tool.title: Get My Lists
tool.description: List the current user's own lists, newest first: each one's name, description and visibility. Public and unlisted lists are always included. Private lists are included only when the credential holds the post-relations.owned-private:write private-data consent scope (the mcp.user:write scope does not include it); without it they are left out as if they did not exist. Returns at most 25 lists per page and page_info.end_cursor; pass it as after to get the next page. A malformed cursor returns { success: false, error: "Invalid cursor" }. Use get_list_items to read inside a list.

after.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page_info.end_cursor, for the next page.

tool.name: get_my_rewards_statuses
tool.title: Get My Rewards Statuses
tool.description: List the current user's rewards program statuses.

after.description: Opaque cursor from the previous status page

limit.description: Number of statuses to return, from 1 to 100

tool.name: get_my_spending
tool.title: Get My Spending
tool.description: List the current user's spending categories.

after.description: Opaque cursor from the prior list page

tool.name: get_post_ancestors
tool.title: Get Post Ancestors
tool.description: Get the parent chain of a comment by its UUID or slug, ordered from the thread root down to its direct parent and not including the comment itself. A root post has no ancestors. A deleted comment in the chain is left out, so a parent_id can name a comment that is not listed. A comment whose thread is not fully public, or that is deleted or missing, returns { success: false, error: "Post not found" }.

post_id.description: Post UUID or slug of the comment

tool.name: get_post_descendants
tool.title: Get Post Descendants
tool.description: Get the replies below a post by its UUID or slug, in id order, one cursor page at a time. Pass page_info.end_cursor as after to read the next page while page_info.has_next_page is true. A reply the public cannot see hides its whole subtree. A deleted reply is left out but the replies below it still appear, so a parent_id can name a reply that is not listed. A post that is not fully public, or that is deleted or missing, returns { success: false, error: "Post not found" }. A malformed or foreign cursor returns { success: false, error: "Invalid cursor" }. A page too large to return is refused, so lower the limit and try again.

after.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page

tool.name: get_post
tool.title: Get Post
tool.description: Get one post, comment or story post by its UUID or slug. Only public content is readable: a private, pending, deleted, missing or otherwise hidden post returns { success: false, error: "Post not found" }. A comment is readable only when its whole thread is. Use get_post_ancestors to walk up a thread and get_post_descendants to read its replies.

tool.name: get_recommended_topics
tool.title: Get Recommended Topics
tool.description: Get personalized topic recommendations based on the current user's activity, including positive post choices, followed feeds, and views. Use this for questions like 'what cards should I look into?' or 'what topics might interest me?'. Returns topic IDs with recommendation scores. Use get_topic_details for full card information.

limit.description: Maximum number of recommendations to return (1-25). Defaults to 10.

tool.name: get_referral_links
tool.title: Get Referral Links
tool.description: Get prioritized referral links for a topic. Ranks links by social connections: mutual follows, follows, referrers, positive-choice authors, then everyone else.

topic_id.description: The topic identifier (UUID or slug) to look up referral links for. Can be a referral program topic or any topic with a linked referral program.

tool.name: get_story
tool.title: Get Story
tool.description: Get one news story by its UUID: its title, why its articles were grouped, and one cursor page of the articles that belong to it, newest first. Pass page_info.end_cursor as after to read the next page while page_info.has_next_page is true. A deleted or missing story returns { success: false, error: "Story not found" }. A malformed cursor returns { success: false, error: "Invalid cursor" }.

after.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page

exclude_item_id.description: UUID of an article to leave out, such as the one being read

tool.name: get_top_hostnames
tool.title: Get Top Hostnames
tool.description: List the most trusted hostnames, as a signed-out reader sees them: hostnames with at least one trust vote up, highest net trust votes first, never an administratively blocked hostname. topic is a topic UUID or slug; a topic that does not exist returns no results. Returns at most 25 hostnames per page and page_info.end_cursor; pass it as after to get the next page. A malformed cursor returns { success: false, error: "Invalid cursor" }.

topic.description: Only hostnames of this topic UUID or slug

after.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page_info.end_cursor, for the next page.

tool.name: get_topic_details
tool.title: Get Topic Details
tool.description: Get detailed information about a topic (card, bank account, rewards program, etc.). For cards, returns the annual fee, issuing bank, and card brand. For rewards programs, returns the parent company. Always includes the full description and aliases. Set hierarchy to also get parent topics (the organization that issues a card) and/or child topics (all cards a bank issues, all tiers in a rewards program); children come one page at a time, so pass children_page_info.end_cursor as children_after for the next page.

topic_id.description: The topic UUID or slug to retrieve details for

hierarchy.description: Also return related topics. "parents" = what this topic belongs to (for example the bank that issues a card), "children" = what belongs to this topic (for example every card a bank issues), "both" = each. Omit for no related topics.

children_after.description: Cursor from a previous result children_page_info.end_cursor, for the next page of children. Only used when hierarchy is "children" or "both".

children_limit.description: Maximum number of children per page. Defaults to 25; values over 100 are clamped to 100. Only used when hierarchy is "children" or "both".

tool.name: get_topic_insights
tool.title: Get Topic Insights
tool.description: Get aggregate data point statistics for a topic (card, bank account, etc.). Returns approval rate, median credit limit, and credit score distribution.

topic_id.description: The topic UUID or slug to aggregate data points for

vertical.description: Optionally filter to a specific data point vertical

tool.name: get_topic_metrics
tool.title: Get Topic Metrics
tool.description: Get engagement metrics for a topic: post counts by type (discussions, reviews, data points, news), follower count, and star rating distribution. Useful for gauging how active and well-reviewed a card or product is.

topic_id.description: The topic UUID or slug to retrieve metrics for

tool.name: get_trending_posts
tool.title: Get Trending Posts
tool.description: Get posts that are trending based on time-decay voting. Useful for "what discussions are hot this week?" or "what are the most popular reviews for this card?". Optionally filter by post type or topic. Returns page_info.end_cursor; pass it as after to get the next page.

time_range.description: Time window for trending calculation. Defaults to "week".

post_type.description: Optionally filter to a specific post type.

topic_id.description: Optionally filter to posts tagged with a specific topic, by UUID or slug.

after.description: Cursor from a previous result page_info.end_cursor, for the next page.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return. Defaults to 20; values over 100 are clamped to 100.

tool.name: get_trending_topics
tool.title: Get Trending Topics
tool.description: Get topics (cards, bank accounts, rewards programs, etc.) that are trending based on recent post and news activity. Useful for answering "what credit cards are popular right now?" or "what topics are being discussed?". Returns topic IDs with trending scores — use get_topic_details to get full card information. Returns page_info.end_cursor; pass it as after to get the next page.

time_range.description: Time window for trending calculation. Defaults to "week".

after.description: Cursor from a previous result page_info.end_cursor, for the next page.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return. Defaults to 20; values over 100 are clamped to 100.

tool.name: get_user
tool.title: Get User
tool.description: Get one user's public profile by UUID or username: username, bio, official-account flag and, only when the user shows their verified badge, the verified name. It is the signed-out profile for every caller, your own included: no email, phone, roles, linked accounts or private settings, ever. A deleted or unknown user returns { success: false, error: "User not found" }. An email address or phone number is not a valid identifier.

tool.name: manage_my_cards
tool.title: Manage My Cards
tool.description: Manage the current user's wallet cards: add, update, or remove them. List them with get_my_cards.

id.description: Required for update and remove actions.

card_id.description: The topic UUID of the card to add (required for action=add)

opened_on.description: Date the card was opened in YYYY-MM-DD format

closed_on.description: Date the card was closed in YYYY-MM-DD format

credit_limit.description: Credit limit in integer minor units paired with its currency

is_authorized_user.description: Whether the user is an authorized user on this card

authorized_user_of_id.description: Wallet-card UUID of the primary account, or null to clear the relationship

received_sign_up_bonus_on.description: Date the sign-up bonus was received in YYYY-MM-DD format

tool.name: manage_my_point_valuations
tool.title: Manage My Point Valuations
tool.description: Manage the current user's rewards program point valuations — how much the user values each rewards program's points.

id.description: Required for update and remove actions.

rewards_program_id.description: The topic UUID of the rewards program (required for action=add)

value_per_point.description: New point value in millionths of the major currency unit

tool.name: manage_my_rewards_statuses
tool.title: Manage My Rewards Statuses
tool.description: Manage the current user's loyalty tier / rewards program statuses (e.g. Gold, Platinum).

id.description: Required for update and remove actions.

rewards_program_status_id.description: The topic UUID of the rewards program status to add (required for action=add)

since.description: Date the status started in YYYY-MM-DD format

until.description: Date the status ends in YYYY-MM-DD format

tool.name: manage_my_spending
tool.title: Manage My Spending
tool.description: Manage the current user's spending by category.

id.description: Required for update and remove actions.

spending_category_id.description: The topic UUID of the spending category (required for action=add)

amount.description: New spending amount in integer minor units paired with its currency

tool.name: remove_bookmark
tool.title: Remove Bookmark
tool.description: Remove a saved, followed, muted, or blocked relation the current user set on an entity. Removing a relation that is not set changes nothing, and the entity does not have to be visible any more.

entity_type.description: The type of entity. Valid types per predicate: save: post, rss_feed_item, url, community; follow: post, topic, user, rss_feed; mute: topic, user, rss_feed, url_hostname; block: topic, user, url_hostname.

predicate.description: The relation: save, follow, mute, or block.

tool.name: remove_list_item
tool.title: Remove List Item
tool.description: Remove a post or an RSS feed item from a list the current user owns. Removing an item that is not on the list fails as not found, and another user's list cannot be changed.

list_id.description: The ID of a list the current user owns.

item_type.description: The kind of item: a post or an RSS feed item.

entity_id.description: The ID of the post or feed item.

tool.name: search_communities
tool.title: Search Communities
tool.description: Search public communities, as a signed-out reader sees them: a private community never appears, whoever asks. q matches names and descriptions and may carry #hashtags. Sorted by name (the default, A to Z), members or virtual_subscriptions (most first). Returns at most 25 communities per page and page_info.end_cursor; pass it as after, with the same sort, to get the next page. A malformed cursor, or one from a different sort, returns { success: false, error: "Invalid cursor" }.

q.description: Keyword search. Same as GET /api/v1/communities q.

sort.description: Sort order: name (A to Z, the default), members (most members first), virtual_subscriptions (most follows first)

after.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page_info.end_cursor, for the next page.

tool.name: search_data_points
tool.title: Search Data Points
tool.description: Search for data point posts with optional JSONB filters. Use this to find approval rates, credit limits, and application outcomes for a specific card or topic.

topic_id.description: Filter by topic UUID or slug (e.g. a specific credit card or bank account topic)

credit_score_range.description: Filter by applicant credit score range

tool.name: search_hostnames
tool.title: Search Hostnames
tool.description: Search the hostnames Voucha knows, as a signed-out reader sees them: an administratively blocked hostname never appears, whoever asks. Each hostname carries its topic_id and its public trust vote totals (election). query and hostname both match part of the hostname. topic is a topic UUID or slug; a topic that does not exist returns no results. Sorted by hostname (A to Z, the default) or, with sort "trust", by net trust votes (highest first). Returns at most 25 hostnames per page and page_info.end_cursor; pass it as after, with the same sort, to get the next page. A malformed cursor, or one from a different sort, returns { success: false, error: "Invalid cursor" }.

query.description: Part of the hostname to match. Same as GET /api/v1/hostnames query.

hostname.description: Part of the hostname to match. Same as GET /api/v1/hostnames hostname.

topic.description: Only hostnames of this topic UUID or slug

sort.description: trust sorts by net trust votes, highest first. Omit it to sort by hostname.

after.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page_info.end_cursor, for the next page.

tool.name: search_posts
tool.title: Search Posts
tool.description: Search for posts using keyword (text_search_query or q), semantic (semantic_search_query), and similar-item signals. Use search for hybrid text+semantic search. Returns page_info.end_cursor; pass it as after to get the next page. A malformed or foreign cursor returns { success: false, error: "Invalid cursor" }.

q.description: Keyword search. Same as GET /api/v1/posts q: matches post text and #hashtags.

search.description: Hybrid search shortcut. Same as setting both text_search_query and semantic_search_query to this value.

text_search_query.description: Text/keyword query for exact or lexical matching

semantic_search_query.description: Natural language query for semantic similarity search

similar_post_id.description: Find results similar to a post ID using embeddings

similar_topic_id.description: Find results similar to a topic ID using embeddings

similar_rss_feed_item_id.description: Find results similar to an RSS feed item UUID

after.description: Cursor from a previous result page_info.end_cursor, for the next page.

limit.description: Maximum number of results per page. Defaults to 25; values over 100 are clamped to 100.

sort.description: Sort order: new (most recent), best (highest voted), hot, relevance (search relevance; the default when searching), following_new

tool.name: search_topics
tool.title: Search Topics
tool.description: Search topics by name or slug (text_search_query or q), by meaning (semantic_search_query), and by similar-item signals. Use search for hybrid text+semantic search. Returns page_info.end_cursor; pass it as after to get the next page. A malformed or foreign cursor returns { success: false, error: "Invalid cursor" }.

q.description: Keyword search. Same as GET /api/v1/topics q: matches topic names and slugs, and #hashtags.

search.description: Hybrid search shortcut. Same as setting both text_search_query and semantic_search_query to this value.

text_search_query.description: Text/keyword query for exact or lexical matching

semantic_search_query.description: Natural language query for semantic similarity search

similar_post_id.description: Find results similar to a post ID using embeddings

similar_topic_id.description: Find results similar to a topic ID using embeddings

similar_rss_feed_item_id.description: Find results similar to an RSS feed item UUID

after.description: Cursor from a previous result page_info.end_cursor, for the next page.

limit.description: Maximum number of results per page. Defaults to 25; values over 100 are clamped to 100.

tool.name: search_users
tool.title: Search Users
tool.description: Search users by the start of their username, case-insensitive, sorted A to Z. Results are public profiles only, as get_user returns them, and never an administrator's view. A blank query returns no results. Returns at most 25 users per page and page_info.end_cursor; pass it as after, with the same q, to get the next page. A malformed cursor, or one from a different q, returns { success: false, error: "Invalid cursor" }.

q.description: The start of the username to find

after.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page_info.end_cursor, for the next page.

tool.name: set_bookmark
tool.title: Set Bookmark
tool.description: Save, follow, mute, or block an entity for the current user. Setting a relation that already exists changes nothing. Muting or blocking a topic, user or feed also removes the user's follow of it. A post is only available if the user can see it; the user's own private posts additionally need the private-post consent scope.

entity_type.description: The type of entity. Valid types per predicate: save: post, rss_feed_item, url, community; follow: post, topic, user, rss_feed; mute: topic, user, rss_feed, url_hostname; block: topic, user, url_hostname.

predicate.description: The relation: save, follow, mute, or block.

tool.name: update_list
tool.title: Update List
tool.description: Change the name, description, or visibility of a list the current user owns. Only the fields sent change; send a null description to clear it. Another user's list cannot be changed.

list_id.description: The ID of a list the current user owns.

description.description: A description of the list, or null for none.

visibility.description: Who can see the list. Lists are private unless set otherwise.

tool.name: update_my_financial_profile
tool.title: Update My Financial Profile
tool.description: Update the current user's financial profile used for personalized data point comparisons. Only provide fields you want to update — omitted fields are unchanged.

currency.description: Currency shared by all of the user's monetary profile values

stated_income_range.description: Annual income range in integer minor units paired with its currency; for example, USD 75,000 to USD 100,000 is {"minimum":{"amount":7500000,"currency":"usd"},"maximum":{"amount":10000000,"currency":"usd"}}

total_credit_limit.description: Total credit limit across all cards in integer minor units paired with its currency; for example, USD 25,000 is {"amount":2500000,"currency":"usd"}

tool.title: Get editorial story
tool.description: Read a news story and one bounded page of its articles for editorial review.

tool.title: List crawlers
